expo._comment_single_listing: RoadMate is ONE Play Store listing — the customer app, the sixth of six (HANDOFF §4). Like apps/rider and unlike apps/business there is no app.config.js and no APP_VARIANT: seven industries are a switcher inside the app, not seven builds. This file is the whole configuration.
expo.name: RoadMate

android._comment_permissions: Foreground location only. The customer app reads a position to answer 'do we deliver here' and to drop a pin on a new address — never in the background. The rider app is the one that reports a position, and only while on shift.

plugins._comment: The wording a customer reads at the prompt. It says what the location is for, because they can always type an address instead — this is a convenience, not a condition of using the app.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: RoadMate uses your location to find shops that deliver to you and to drop a pin when you save a new address.

plugins._comment: Prescription upload (2026-08-09). Only pharmacy orders ever ask for this, and the prompt says what the photo is for — it is a medical record and is stored privately, not a product photo.
plugins.photosPermission: RoadMate needs access to your photos so you can attach a prescription to a pharmacy order.
plugins.cameraPermission: RoadMate uses the camera so you can photograph a prescription for a pharmacy order. It is stored privately and seen only by the pharmacist checking it.

extra._comment_apiUrl: Overridden per environment. A phone cannot reach the API on localhost — this must be the dev machine's LAN address (see .env.example).

expo._comment_icons: TODO(design): RoadMate needs its own icon and store screenshots. It currently ships apps/business's placeholder art, as apps/rider does. Assets only, no code.
